<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Happy 16th, Sofia! 🎂</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Caveat:wght@500;700&family=Patrick+Hand&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#2d4566;
    --cream:#faf3e3;
    --blue:#6aa2d9;
    --blue-deep:#3f6ea3;
    box-sizing:border-box;
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{
    height:100%;
    margin:0;
  }
  html{scroll-padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);}
  body{
    min-height:100%;
    font-family:'Patrick Hand', sans-serif;
    color:var(--ink);
    background-color:#6aa2d9;
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 15%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12), transparent 55%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 80%, rgba(0,0,0,0.08), transparent 55%);
    background-attachment:fixed;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]) body{ background-color:#3f6ea3; }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"] body{ background-color:#3f6ea3; }

  .stage{
    min-height:100vh;
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-start;
    justify-content:center;
    padding: 8vh 16px 60px;
    position:relative;
  }

  /* ---------- decorative scrapbook bits ---------- */
  .tape{
    position:absolute;
    background:rgba(250,243,227,0.55);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    opacity:0.85;
  }

  /* ---------- COVER ---------- */
  #coverStage{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:18px;
    transition: opacity .5s ease, transform .5s ease;
  }
  #coverStage.hidden{
    opacity:0;
    pointer-events:none;
    transform:scale(0.9);
    position:absolute;
    top:8vh;
  }
  .cover-card{
    width:min(84vw, 480px);
    cursor:pointer;
    position:relative;
    transform:rotate(-2deg);
    filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 30px rgba(30,20,10,0.45));
    transition:transform .35s ease;
    animation: floaty 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .cover-card:active{ transform:rotate(-2deg) scale(0.97); }
  @keyframes floaty{
    0%,100%{ transform:rotate(-2deg) translateY(0); }
    50%{ transform:rotate(-1.2deg) translateY(-6px); }
  }
  .cover-card img{
    width:100%;
    display:block;
    border:10px solid #fffdf8;
    border-bottom-width:34px;
    border-radius:2px;
  }
  .cover-hint{
    font-family:'Caveat',cursive;
    font-size:1.5rem;
    color:var(--cream);
    text-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    animation: pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse{ 0%,100%{opacity:.6;} 50%{opacity:1;} }

  /* ---------- BOOK / SPREAD ---------- */
  #bookStage{
    display:none;
    width:100%;
    max-width:1040px;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:16px;
    perspective:2200px;
  }
  #bookStage.visible{ display:flex; }

  .spread{
    display:flex;
    gap:14px;
    width:100%;
    justify-content:center;
    transform-origin:center top;
    animation: openUp .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);
  }
  @keyframes openUp{
    0%{ opacity:0; transform:scale(.85) rotateX(8deg); }
    100%{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1) rotateX(0); }
  }
  .page{
    background:var(--cream);
    border-radius:3px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 40px rgba(20,12,4,0.4), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
    width:min(46vw, 480px);
    aspect-ratio: 707/1000;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .page-left{ border-right:2px dashed rgba(0,0,0,0.12); }
  .page-right{}

  .backBtn{
    font-family:'Patrick Hand',sans-serif;
    font-size:1rem;
    background:var(--cream);
    border:2px solid var(--ink);
    color:var(--ink);
    padding:8px 18px;
    border-radius:22px;
    cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  }
  .backBtn:active{ transform:translateY(1px); }

  /* ---------- LETTER PAGE ---------- */
  .letter-scene{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  }
  .envelope-wrap{
    width:82%;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition: opacity .45s ease, transform .45s ease;
    filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.25));
  }
  .envelope-wrap img{ width:100%; display:block; border-radius:2px; }
  .envelope-wrap .tap-hint{
    text-align:center;
    font-family:'Caveat',cursive;
    font-size:1.15rem;
    color:var(--blue-deep);
    margin-top:2px;
  }
  .letter-scene.open .envelope-wrap{
    opacity:0;
    transform:scale(.85) translateY(10%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }

  /* Letter pop-up (full lightbox so it can be read easily) */
  #letterModal{
    position:fixed; inset:0;
    background:rgba(25,38,58,0.75);
    display:none;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    z-index:60;
    padding:24px;
  }
  #letterModal.show{ display:flex; }
  .letter-pop{
    position:relative;
    width:min(92vw, 540px);
    max-height:88vh;
    overflow:auto;
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:4px;
    box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
    cursor:pointer;
    transform:scale(.7) rotate(-2deg);
    opacity:0;
    transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.25), opacity .3s ease;
  }
  #letterModal.show .letter-pop{
    transform:scale(1) rotate(0deg);
    opacity:1;
  }
  .letter-pop img{ width:100%; display:block; }
  .closeLetter{
    position:absolute; top:8px; right:10px;
    width:32px; height:32px;
    border-radius:50%;
    border:none;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
    font-size:1.1rem;
    line-height:1;
    cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }

  /* ---------- CANDLES PAGE ---------- */
  .candle-scene{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  }
  .cake-wrap{
    position:relative;
    width:96%;
  }
  .cake-wrap img.cake-img{ width:100%; display:block; }
  .flame{
    position:absolute;
    transform-origin:50% 80%;
    pointer-events:none;
    will-change: transform, opacity;
  }
  .flame img{ width:100%; display:block; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,200,80,0.6)); }
  .flame.lit{ animation: flicker 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes flicker{
    0%,100%{ transform: rotate(0deg) scaleY(1); }
    25%{ transform: rotate(-2deg) scaleY(1.03); }
    50%{ transform: rotate(1.5deg) scaleY(0.98); }
    75%{ transform: rotate(-1deg) scaleY(1.02); }
  }
  .flame.blowing{ transition: transform .08s linear; }
  .flame.out{
    opacity:0;
    transition: opacity .35s ease, transform .35s ease;
    transform: rotate(70deg) scaleY(0.2);
  }
  .smoke{
    position:absolute;
    width:10px; height:10px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(180,180,180,0.55);
    pointer-events:none;
    opacity:0;
  }

  .mic-panel{
    position:absolute;
    left:50%; bottom:4%;
    transform:translateX(-50%);
    width:88%;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:6px;
  }
  .meter{
    width:100%;
    max-width:220px;
    height:12px;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
    border-radius:8px;
    overflow:hidden;
    border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
  }
  .meter-fill{
    height:100%;
    width:0%;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7fb3e0,#3f6ea3);
    transition:width .06s linear;
  }
  .mic-row{
    display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center;
  }
  .micBtn, .blowBtn{
    font-family:'Patrick Hand',sans-serif;
    font-size:0.85rem;
    padding:7px 14px;
    border-radius:18px;
    border:2px solid var(--blue-deep);
    background:#fff;
    color:var(--blue-deep);
    cursor:pointer;
    user-select:none;
  }
  .blowBtn:active, .blowBtn.holding{ background:var(--blue-deep); color:#fff; }
  .mic-note{
    font-size:0.72rem;
    color:#6a5a45;
    text-align:center;
    max-width:240px;
    line-height:1.3;
  }

  .wish-overlay{
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    gap:14px;
    background:rgba(250,243,227,0.94);
    opacity:0;
    pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity .5s ease;
    text-align:center;
    padding:20px;
  }
  .wish-overlay.show{ opacity:1; pointer-events:auto; }
  .wish-overlay h2{
    font-family:'Caveat',cursive;
    font-size:2.1rem;
    color:var(--blue-deep);
    margin:0;
  }
  .relightBtn, .photosBtn{
    font-family:'Patrick Hand',sans-serif;
    font-size:1rem;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--ink);
    padding:9px 18px;
    border-radius:20px;
    border:2px solid var(--ink);
    background:#fff;
    cursor:pointer;
    white-space:nowrap;
    line-height:1.4;
  }

  .confetti-piece{
    position:absolute;
    top:-10px;
    width:8px; height:14px;
    opacity:0.95;
    pointer-events:none;
    animation-name: confettiFall;
    animation-timing-function: linear;
    animation-fill-mode: forwards;
  }
  @keyframes confettiFall{
    0%{ transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg); opacity:1; }
    100%{ transform:translateY(420px) rotate(540deg); opacity:0; }
  }

  /* ---------- PHOTO MODAL ---------- */
  #photoModal{
    position:fixed; inset:0;
    background:rgba(60,44,26,0.72);
    display:none;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    z-index:50;
    padding:20px;
  }
  #photoModal.show{ display:flex; }
  .photo-sheet{
    background:var(--cream);
    border-radius:8px;
    width:min(94vw, 760px);
    max-height:90vh;
    overflow:auto;
    padding:22px 14px 26px;
    position:relative;
    box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }
  .photo-sheet h3{
    text-align:center;
    font-family:'Caveat',cursive;
    font-size:1.8rem;
    color:var(--blue-deep);
    margin:0 0 10px;
  }
  .closeModal{
    position:absolute; top:10px; right:12px;
    background:none; border:none;
    font-size:1.4rem;
    cursor:pointer;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .cam-anim{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    position:relative;
    width:min(72%, 300px);
    aspect-ratio: 707 / 1000;
    margin:0 auto;
  }
  .cam-anim img{
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
    object-fit:contain;
  }
  .cam-anim #camFlash{ opacity:0; }
  .cam-anim.flashing #camFlash{ opacity:1; }
  .cam-anim.flashing #camBase{ opacity:0; }

  .photo-stage{
    position:relative;
    width:min(100%, 440px);
    margin:0 auto;
  }
  .photo-backdrop{
    width:100%;
    display:block;
    opacity:0;
    transform:scale(.92);
    transition:opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease;
    border-radius:4px;
  }
  .photo-stage.reveal .photo-backdrop{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1); }

  .photo-col{
    position:absolute;
    top:50%;
    transform:translateY(-50%);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:6%;
    width:27%;
  }
  .photo-col.left{ left:1%; }
  .photo-col.right{ right:1%; }
  .photo-col img{
    width:100%;
    display:block;
    box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    border-radius:2px;
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateY(70px) rotate(0deg);
    transition:opacity .5s ease, transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1.3);
  }
  .photo-col.left img:nth-child(1){ transition-delay:.35s; }
  .photo-col.left img:nth-child(2){ transition-delay:.5s; }
  .photo-col.left img:nth-child(3){ transition-delay:.65s; }
  .photo-col.right img:nth-child(1){ transition-delay:.4s; }
  .photo-col.right img:nth-child(2){ transition-delay:.55s; }
  .photo-col.right img:nth-child(3){ transition-delay:.7s; }

  .photo-stage.reveal .photo-col.left img:nth-child(1){ transform:translateY(0) rotate(-7deg); opacity:1; }
  .photo-stage.reveal .photo-col.left img:nth-child(2){ transform:translateY(0) rotate(5deg); opacity:1; }
  .photo-stage.reveal .photo-col.left img:nth-child(3){ transform:translateY(0) rotate(-4deg); opacity:1; }
  .photo-stage.reveal .photo-col.right img:nth-child(1){ transform:translateY(0) rotate(7deg); opacity:1; }
  .photo-stage.reveal .photo-col.right img:nth-child(2){ transform:translateY(0) rotate(-5deg); opacity:1; }
  .photo-stage.reveal .photo-col.right img:nth-child(3){ transform:translateY(0) rotate(4deg); opacity:1; }

  #bgYt{
    position:fixed;
    width:1px; height:1px;
    top:-9999px; left:-9999px;
    border:0;
    opacity:0;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  #musicToggle{
    position:fixed;
    top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px);
    right:14px;
    z-index:70;
    width:42px; height:42px;
    border-radius:50%;
    border:2px solid var(--ink);
    background:#fff;
    font-size:1.15rem;
    cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }

  @media (max-width:520px){
    .page{ width:45vw; }
    .stage{ padding-top:6vh; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<button id="musicToggle" type="button" title="Toggle music">🔈</button>
<iframe id="bgYt" title="background music"
  src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/-V54jzi8uXE?enablejsapi=1&autoplay=1&mute=1&loop=1&playlist=-V54jzi8uXE&controls=0"
  allow="autoplay" frameborder="0"></iframe>

<div class="stage">

  <!-- COVER -->
  <div id="coverStage">
    <div class="cover-card" id="coverCard">
      <img src="" id="coverImg" alt="Cover">
    </div>
    <div class="cover-hint">tap to open ✨</div>
  </div>

  <!-- BOOK -->
  <div id="bookStage">
    <div class="spread" id="spread">

      <!-- LEFT PAGE: LETTER -->
      <div class="page page-left">
        <div class="letter-scene" id="letterScene">
          <div class="envelope-wrap" id="envelopeWrap">
            <img src="" id="envelopeImg" alt="Envelope with letter">
            <div class="tap-hint">tap the letter to read it</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- RIGHT PAGE: CANDLES -->
      <div class="page page-right">
        <div class="candle-scene" id="candleScene">
          <div class="cake-wrap" id="cakeWrap">
            <img class="cake-img" src="" id="cakeImg" alt="Cake with candles">
            <!-- flames injected by JS -->
          </div>

          <div class="mic-panel">
            <div class="meter"><div class="meter-fill" id="meterFill"></div></div>
            <div class="mic-row">
              <button class="micBtn" id="micBtn" type="button">🎤 enable mic</button>
              <button class="blowBtn" id="blowBtn" type="button">💨 hold to blow (or press space)</button>
            </div>
            <div class="mic-note">Blowing needs this page hosted over https — if the mic's blocked, hold the button or press space instead.</div>
          </div>

          <div class="wish-overlay" id="wishOverlay">
            <h2 id="wishText">make a wish, Sofia!</h2>
            <button class="photosBtn" id="photosBtn" type="button">📸 our memories</button>
            <button class="relightBtn" id="relightBtn" type="button">🔥 relight candles</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>

    <button class="backBtn" id="backBtn" type="button">← back to cover</button>
  </div>

</div>

<!-- LETTER MODAL -->
<div id="letterModal">
  <div class="letter-pop" id="letterPop">
    <button class="closeLetter" id="closeLetter" type="button">✕</button>
    <img src="" id="letterImg" alt="Full letter">
  </div>
</div>

<!-- PHOTO MODAL -->
<div id="photoModal">
  <div class="photo-sheet">
    <button class="closeModal" id="closeModal" type="button">✕</button>
    <h3>our memories 💙</h3>
    <div class="cam-anim" id="camAnim">
      <img src="" id="camBase" alt="">
      <img src="" id="camFlash" alt="">
    </div>
    <div class="photo-stage" id="photoStage">
      <img class="photo-backdrop" src="" id="pmid" alt="Camera and photobooth strip">
      <div class="photo-col left">
        <img src="" id="pl1" alt="">
        <img src="" id="pl2" alt="">
        <img src="" id="pl3" alt="">
      </div>
      <div class="photo-col right">
        <img src="" id="pr1" alt="">
        <img src="" id="pr2" alt="">
        <img src="" id="pr3" alt="">
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const IMG = {"cover": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cake": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "envelope": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "letter": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "cam1": "data:image/png;base64,", "cam2": "data:image/png;base64,", "midstrip": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "left1": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "left2": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "left3": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "right1": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "right2": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "right3": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "flame0": "data:image/png;base64,", "flame1": "data:image/png;base64,", "flame2": "data:image/png;base64,", "flame3": "data:image/png;base64,", "flame4": "data:image/png;base64,", "flame5": "data:image/png;base64,", "flame6": "data:image/png;base64,", "flame7": "data:image/png;base64,", "flame8": "data:image/png;base64,"};

</script>
<script>
/* ============ WIRE UP IMAGES ============ */
document.getElementById('coverImg').src = IMG.cover;
document.getElementById('envelopeImg').src = IMG.envelope;
document.getElementById('letterImg').src = IMG.letter;
document.getElementById('cakeImg').src = IMG.cake;
document.getElementById('camBase').src = IMG.cam1;
document.getElementById('camFlash').src = IMG.cam2;
document.getElementById('pmid').src = IMG.midstrip;
document.getElementById('pl1').src = IMG.left1;
document.getElementById('pl2').src = IMG.left2;
document.getElementById('pl3').src = IMG.left3;
document.getElementById('pr1').src = IMG.right1;
document.getElementById('pr2').src = IMG.right2;
document.getElementById('pr3').src = IMG.right3;

/* ============ FLAME POSITIONS (computed from source image, % of cake image box) ============ */
const FLAMES = [
  {left:23.76, top:58.20, width:3.47, height:4.10, ox:50.0, oy:78.0},
  {left:30.13, top:58.35, width:3.25, height:4.05, ox:50.0, oy:77.8},
  {left:36.63, top:57.90, width:3.32, height:4.20, ox:50.0, oy:78.6},
  {left:42.93, top:57.25, width:3.47, height:4.50, ox:50.0, oy:80.0},
  {left:50.35, top:55.60, width:3.39, height:4.35, ox:50.0, oy:79.3},
  {left:56.93, top:57.75, width:3.54, height:4.90, ox:50.0, oy:81.6},
  {left:63.08, top:57.85, width:3.54, height:4.75, ox:50.0, oy:81.1},
  {left:69.38, top:58.20, width:3.68, height:4.45, ox:50.0, oy:79.8},
  {left:76.52, top:57.95, width:3.54, height:4.70, ox:50.0, oy:80.9},
];

const cakeWrap = document.getElementById('cakeWrap');
const flameEls = [];
FLAMES.forEach((f, i) => {
  const wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.className = 'flame lit';
  wrap.style.left = f.left + '%';
  wrap.style.top = f.top + '%';
  wrap.style.width = f.width + '%';
  wrap.style.height = f.height + '%';
  wrap.style.transformOrigin = f.ox + '% ' + f.oy + '%';
  wrap.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.13) + 's';
  const img = document.createElement('img');
  img.src = IMG['flame' + i];
  wrap.appendChild(img);
  cakeWrap.appendChild(wrap);
  flameEls.push(wrap);
});

/* ============ COVER -> BOOK ============ */
const coverStage = document.getElementById('coverStage');
const bookStage = document.getElementById('bookStage');
const coverCard = document.getElementById('coverCard');
const backBtn = document.getElementById('backBtn');

function openBook(){
  coverStage.classList.add('hidden');
  bookStage.classList.add('visible');
  startMusic();
}
function closeBook(){
  bookStage.classList.remove('visible');
  coverStage.classList.remove('hidden');
  // reset letter + candles state when returning to cover
  document.getElementById('letterScene').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('letterModal').classList.remove('show');
}
coverCard.addEventListener('click', openBook);
backBtn.addEventListener('click', closeBook);

/* ============ LETTER ============ */
const letterScene = document.getElementById('letterScene');
const envelopeWrap = document.getElementById('envelopeWrap');
const letterModal = document.getElementById('letterModal');
const letterPop = document.getElementById('letterPop');
const closeLetter = document.getElementById('closeLetter');

function openLetter(){
  letterScene.classList.add('open');
  letterModal.classList.add('show');
}
function closeLetterPop(){
  letterModal.classList.remove('show');
  letterScene.classList.remove('open');
}
envelopeWrap.addEventListener('click', openLetter);
letterPop.addEventListener('click', closeLetterPop);
closeLetter.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); closeLetterPop(); });
letterModal.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.target === letterModal) closeLetterPop(); });

/* ============ CANDLES / MIC BLOW DETECTION ============ */
const meterFill = document.getElementById('meterFill');
const micBtn = document.getElementById('micBtn');
const blowBtn = document.getElementById('blowBtn');
const wishOverlay = document.getElementById('wishOverlay');
const relightBtn = document.getElementById('relightBtn');
const photosBtn = document.getElementById('photosBtn');
const candleScene = document.getElementById('candleScene');

let audioCtx = null, analyser = null, micStream = null, micData = null, rafId = null;
let candlesLit = true;
let blowStartTime = null;
const BLOW_THRESHOLD = 18;   // level 0-100 scale
const BLOW_HOLD_MS = 500;

function setLevel(pct){
  pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));
  meterFill.style.width = pct + '%';
}

function bendFlames(strength){
  // strength 0..1
  flameEls.forEach((el, i) => {
    el.classList.add('blowing');
    const dir = (i % 2 === 0) ? 1 : 1; // all bend same general direction (as if wind blows one way)
    const angle = 55 * strength * dir;
    const scaleY = 1 - 0.35 * strength;
    el.style.transform = `rotate(${angle}deg) scaleY(${scaleY})`;
  });
}
function resetFlameBend(){
  flameEls.forEach(el => {
    el.classList.remove('blowing');
    el.style.transform = '';
  });
}

function extinguishCandles(){
  if(!candlesLit) return;
  candlesLit = false;
  flameEls.forEach(el => {
    el.classList.remove('lit','blowing');
    el.classList.add('out');
  });
  setTimeout(() => {
    wishOverlay.classList.add('show');
    launchConfetti();
  }, 300);
  stopMic();
}

function relightCandles(){
  candlesLit = true;
  flameEls.forEach(el => {
    el.classList.remove('out');
    el.classList.add('lit');
    el.style.transform = '';
  });
  wishOverlay.classList.remove('show');
  setLevel(0);
  blowStartTime = null;
}
relightBtn.addEventListener('click', relightCandles);
photosBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openPhotoModal());

async function enableMic(){
  if(!(navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia)){
    micBtn.textContent = '🎤 mic not supported here';
    micBtn.disabled = true;
    return;
  }
  try{
    micStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true});
    audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(micStream);
    analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 512;
    analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.6;
    source.connect(analyser);
    micData = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
    micBtn.textContent = '🎤 mic on — blow!';
    micBtn.disabled = true;
    micListen();
  }catch(err){
    micBtn.textContent = '🎤 mic blocked — use hold button';
    micBtn.disabled = true;
  }
}
micBtn.addEventListener('click', enableMic);

function micListen(){
  if(!analyser || !candlesLit){ rafId = requestAnimationFrame(micListen); return; }
  analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(micData);
  let sumSquares = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<micData.length;i++){
    const v = (micData[i]-128)/128;
    sumSquares += v*v;
  }
  const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSquares/micData.length);
  const level = Math.min(100, rms*260);
  setLevel(level);

  if(level > BLOW_THRESHOLD){
    if(blowStartTime === null) blowStartTime = performance.now();
    const strength = Math.min(1, level/70);
    bendFlames(strength);
    const held = performance.now() - blowStartTime;
    if(held > BLOW_HOLD_MS){
      extinguishCandles();
    }
  } else {
    blowStartTime = null;
    resetFlameBend();
  }
  rafId = requestAnimationFrame(micListen);
}

function stopMic(){
  if(rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
  rafId = null;
  if(micStream){ micStream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); micStream = null; }
  if(audioCtx){ audioCtx.close(); audioCtx = null; }
  analyser = null;
}

/* ---- Fallback: hold-to-blow button + spacebar ---- */
let holdTimer = null, holdRaf = null, holdStart = null;
function startHold(){
  if(!candlesLit || holdStart) return;
  holdStart = performance.now();
  blowBtn.classList.add('holding');
  const step = () => {
    if(!holdStart) return;
    const elapsed = performance.now() - holdStart;
    const pct = Math.min(100, (elapsed/BLOW_HOLD_MS)*100);
    setLevel(pct);
    bendFlames(Math.min(1, pct/100));
    if(elapsed >= BLOW_HOLD_MS){
      extinguishCandles();
      endHold();
      return;
    }
    holdRaf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };
  holdRaf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
}
function endHold(){
  holdStart = null;
  blowBtn.classList.remove('holding');
  if(holdRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(holdRaf);
  holdRaf = null;
  if(candlesLit){ resetFlameBend(); setLevel(0); }
}
blowBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', startHold);
blowBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e)=>{ e.preventDefault(); startHold(); }, {passive:false});
['mouseup','mouseleave','touchend','touchcancel'].forEach(ev=>{
  blowBtn.addEventListener(ev, endHold);
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
  if(e.code === 'Space' && bookStage.classList.contains('visible') && !letterScene.classList.contains('open')){
    e.preventDefault();
    startHold();
  }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', (e)=>{
  if(e.code === 'Space') endHold();
});

/* ============ CONFETTI ============ */
function launchConfetti(){
  const colors = ['#6f96c9','#3f6ea3','#f4e4c1','#a7c4e8','#fdfaf1','#8b6f4e'];
  for(let i=0;i<46;i++){
    const piece = document.createElement('div');
    piece.className = 'confetti-piece';
    piece.style.left = (Math.random()*100) + '%';
    piece.style.background = colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)];
    piece.style.animationDuration = (1.2 + Math.random()*1.1) + 's';
    piece.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*0.4) + 's';
    piece.style.width = (5+Math.random()*5) + 'px';
    piece.style.height = (10+Math.random()*8) + 'px';
    candleScene.appendChild(piece);
    setTimeout(()=>piece.remove(), 2800);
  }
}

/* ============ PHOTO MODAL ============ */
const photoModal = document.getElementById('photoModal');
const camAnim = document.getElementById('camAnim');
const photoStage = document.getElementById('photoStage');
const closeModal = document.getElementById('closeModal');

function openPhotoModal(){
  photoModal.classList.add('show');
  camAnim.classList.remove('flashing');
  camAnim.style.display = 'flex';
  camAnim.style.opacity = '1';
  photoStage.classList.remove('reveal');
  setTimeout(()=> camAnim.classList.add('flashing'), 400);
  setTimeout(()=>{
    camAnim.style.opacity = '0';
    photoStage.classList.add('reveal');
  }, 750);
  setTimeout(()=>{ camAnim.style.display='none'; }, 1300);
}
function closePhotoModal(){
  photoModal.classList.remove('show');
  camAnim.style.display = 'flex';
  camAnim.style.opacity = '1';
}
closeModal.addEventListener('click', closePhotoModal);
photoModal.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.target === photoModal) closePhotoModal(); });

/* ============ BACKGROUND MUSIC ============ */
const bgYt = document.getElementById('bgYt');
const musicToggle = document.getElementById('musicToggle');
let musicStarted = false;
let musicMuted = true;

function ytCommand(func, args){
  try{
    bgYt.contentWindow.postMessage(JSON.stringify({event:'command', func:func, args: args || []}), '*');
  }catch(e){}
}
function startMusic(){
  if(musicStarted) return;
  musicStarted = true;
  ytCommand('unMute');
  ytCommand('playVideo');
  musicMuted = false;
  musicToggle.textContent = '🔊';
}
function toggleMusic(){
  if(musicMuted){
    ytCommand('unMute');
    ytCommand('playVideo');
    musicMuted = false;
    musicToggle.textContent = '🔊';
  } else {
    ytCommand('mute');
    musicMuted = true;
    musicToggle.textContent = '🔈';
  }
  musicStarted = true;
}
musicToggle.addEventListener('click', toggleMusic);
</script>
</body>
</html>
